name: band alternate low row with twist
description: An alternating band row with a rotation, training your back and the muscles that twist your trunk.
instructions: Anchor a band in front of you at low height and hold both handles.
Stand in a staggered stance with arms extended.
Pull one handle back toward your hip while rotating your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
